items.evidence: Notes: 'New office space details and constraints clarified ... bathrooms, and views of the old town and mountains'; sixth floor Unimail building, room types.

People-per-room question covered ('furniture layout limits adding more than the specified occupants per room'), but the lounge is presented as a 'priority'/'key' rather than as a question of whether it is needed (Susan asked 'Do we really need that?').
Furniture and equipment constraints covered (desks, filing cabinets, photocopier, printer, whiteboards), but the question of what happens if the group does not get the space is not mentioned.
'Room Assignment Strategy' section: arrangement freedom, preferences, grouping options.

Notes cover sharing with assistants, project grouping, phone calls, splitting rooms with walls, meeting rooms for projects, visitors, smoking on balconies, Gisela's noise and admin space. Cubicles not mentioned.
'Coffee and vending machines available within the building, but no dedicated cafeteria'; first and third floors.
Action item for Andrei: 'Investigate the possibility and administrative feasibility of physically splitting rooms'.
Action item for Andrei: 'Ask about administrative or assistant location options in school offices ... including possibility of sharing with related admin staff'.
'Next steps include collecting concrete seating proposals with names and preferences from all members'.
All participants: 'Poll colleagues and assistants for their personal preferences on office sharing'.
Notes mention proposals being merged, but do not clearly state the team will build one coherent proposal from the preferences.
'Multiple proposals will be merged and negotiated with the other group's suggestions.'
Task present but assigned to Andrei ('Follow up with absent team members (Maggie, Pierrette)'); in the transcript Susan (Speaker C) said she would ask them.
'Schedule next meeting for Tuesday afternoon (around 14:00)'.
'Since projects evolve and people work on multiple projects, grouping by project is less practical.'

Notes: 'Options include giving admin a one-person room or a two-person room, but the second desk's use remains unclear.' The transcript shows no firm decision: Andre floated a visitor in Gisella's two-person room and Speaker D objected that it is unrealistic for senior visitors, so the notes match the transcript better than the key.
'no dedicated cafeteria'.
'The furniture layout limits adding more than the specified occupants per room, though squeezing four desks in a three-person room might be possible.'
'Preference gathering emphasized as critical for success'; unexpressed preferences risk.
Notes discuss sharing with assistants vs grouping by project groups.
'Splitting rooms to create private offices was discussed but currently not feasible'; cubicles not mentioned.
Lounge discussed and 'exact purpose remain open', but whether it is needed at all is not stated as a question.
'Visitor accommodation limited to one desk at a time'; lounge as overflow for visitors.
'Gisela's role involves high communication and noise, making shared office space difficult.'
'Administrative workspace challenges identified due to lack of single rooms and noise issues.'
Cafeteria question covered: 'no dedicated cafeteria', cafeterias close at 5 PM.
'two vending machines on the first and third floors for coffee'.

errors.claim: Action item for Andrei: 'Follow up with absent team members (Maggie, Pierrette) to gather their office arrangement preferences'
errors.why_wrong: Susan (Speaker C) volunteered: 'I'll ask Maggie and Pierrette if they have any preferences.'

errors.claim: Action item for Andrei: 'Distribute documents of the new office configuration to all participants'
errors.why_wrong: Andre handed out documents during the meeting; it was not a follow-up task.

errors.claim: 'Lounge Priority: A lounge/reading room is key...' and 'Management recognizes this as a priority'
errors.why_wrong: The lounge was questioned (Susan: 'Do we really need that?') and Speaker D said no final decision had been taken on its use.

errors.claim: 'merge proposals with another group before next Tuesday's review meeting'
errors.why_wrong: Each group would bring its proposal to the next meeting and they would be merged or negotiated afterwards, when the other one is available, not before Tuesday.

errors.claim: 'The session will focus on refining the plan rather than final decisions.'
errors.why_wrong: Nothing was said about the focus of the next meeting being refinement rather than decisions.
